thread:
Maya: OK team — final sync on the latency vs cost narrative for the benchmark deliverable + webinar hooks. Put quick asks here so we can lock slides by EOD.
Sam: high level — we need one hero claim, one nuance chart, one CTA path. simple.
Owen: hero claim candidate: "Up to 4x lower tokens-per-second cost at 95th latency SLO" (rough numbers from today's run). I can publish the table.
Priya: visual ask — keep hero chart clean: left axis cost per 1k tokens, right axis p95 latency. Use colored bands for deployment mode (hosted/dedicated/private).
Lina: copy options for hero CTA: 1) Try the hosted API (free credits) 2) Book a Dedicated demo 3) Webinar signup — want 1 primary. leaning toward Try first.
Maya: prefer Webinar as primary for launch, but CTA on the page should be Try API (we’ll A/B). Webinar for nurture list.
Sam: inbound routing — we should tag leads by CTA: signup_webinar, try_api, book_dedicated. Ops wants mapping to MQL tiers.
Kai: field ops note — for book_dedicated leads, route to AE queue #dedicated-inbox. For try_api, send to product-led nurture flow.
Owen: quick data check: when we ran 10k requests parallel we saw median latency 45ms, p95 210ms for quantized model on A100. Cost delta vs baseline about 3.7x — I’ll add confidence intervals.
Lina: headline drafts: "Serve production LLMs with predictable latency and a fraction of the token cost" or "Better latency, better unit economics. Pick the right serving mode." Thoughts?
Priya: second headline feels a bit vague. First reads clearer for marketing. For slides, we can split: short headline + one-liner.
Maya: slide structure proposal — Slide 1: headline + hero chart. Slide 2: methodology (short). Slide 3: slices (SMB, SaaS, enterprise) with recommended deployments. Slide 4: CTA + routing.
Sam: methodology snippet for slide 2 (short): "Standardized workload: 2k prompt tokens, 256 generation tokens, mixed batch sizes; compare same model variants across hosting modes with default batching."
Owen: please use this bullet for methodology. Also include note: "KV cache warm start used for 60% requests" — it materially affects cost.
Lina: webinar deck hook lines: "How we cut token costs without breaking latency SLOs" and a short teaser: "Real workload examples, live Q+A, and cost-saving tactics your eng team can use tomorrow."
Priya: design asks: 1) show 3-panel slider for slices, 2) animate transition from hosted->dedicated to show cost reduction, 3) small footnote for quantization/precision tradeoffs.
Maya: audience segmentation — webinars: invite product/infra leads at mid-market & up; demo funnel: AE outreach to 100+ employee accounts who click book_dedicated.
Sam: lead scoring rule proposal: try_api=score 10, webinar=score 6, book_dedicated=score 30. Also add company_size>500 => +20 to score.
Kai: operationally we can tag company_size using Clearbit enrichment in the GA->CRM flow. I’ll coordinate.
bench-bot: automated run complete: public_chart CSV uploaded to drive: https://redwood-internal/reports/latency_cost_1768500000 (permissions: marketing-view).
Owen: thanks bot. I’ll pull the CSV and produce the hero PNG. Expect to drop into Figma by 3pm.
Lina: final copy to approve: "See how Redwood Inference tunes serving to cut per-token spend while holding p95 latency. Join our webinar or try the API." Approve?
Priya: approved from design POV. Need final figure by 3:30 to finish layout.
Sam: I'll draft the landing page routing rules and post in #growth after lunch.
Maya: sweet. Action items: Owen — final numbers + hero PNG by 3pm. Priya — layout and animation by 4pm. Lina — finalize copy + webinar blurbs by 4pm. Sam/Kai — routing + enrichment mapping by EOD. I’ll assemble slides and send for review at 5.
Lina: noted. small tweak: CTA order on landing — Try API primary, Webinar secondary (per Maya), Book Dedicated tertiary.
Maya: yep. Also we should include a micro testimonial from a beta customer on slide 3 — @Kai do we have one?
Kai: pinged ops — two customers ok with short quote. I’ll add them to the slide deck.
Sam: tiny test idea: run two landing variants — variant A (webinar-primary) variant B (try-primary) and measure conversion over 72 hours.
Maya: good. let’s do that as part of the launch plan. thanks everyone — will post the assembled deck link here when ready. :rocket:
Priya: :thumbsup:
Owen: on it.
file_notes: marketing thread — narrative + inbound routing for latency/cost benchmark + webinar. single-thread, short Slack style.
